best_echo_sets.commentary: Offers a 10% unconditional ATK% boost and an additional 5% ATK% for every 1.5 seconds the equipped character has been actively on-field - up to 20% after 6 seconds, totalling 30% additional ATK% after fully ramped. This set is completely incompatible with quickswap playstyles, but for the hypercarry playstyle Lingyang will generally use, this is his best set by a small margin.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Very easy echo to use that should be used at the very beginning of the burst window right after the Intro. Thanks to its instant cast there is no thinking required and you can enjoy your ATK% boost and some nice burst damage.

best_echo_sets.commentary: This set grants permanent Resonance Skill DMG% and even bigger Glacio and Skill DMG increases when casting Skill and Liberation respectively. While the second Skill DMG boost is not upkept consistently by Lingyang, he does benefit from the stat and the Glacio DMG boost is additionally appreciated, making it his second best set and his best set that can be used in quickswap compositions.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: The Sentry Construct is the most effective Main echo choice for Frosty Resolve users thanks to its passive 12% Glacio and Resonance Skill DMG% bonuses which are active at all times. The transformation ability of Sentry Construct is also powerful, swap cancellable, usable in the air and accessible more often than other Echoes, thanks to its ability to recharge cooldown when the user activates their Resonance Liberation.

best_echo_sets.commentary: Offers a 10% unconditional Glacio DMG% boost and up to an additional 30% Glacio DMG% after you land 3 Basic or Heavy Attacks for a grand total of 40% additional Glacio damage after fully ramped.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Provides a total of 12% Glacio and Skill DMG boosts when casting all 3 hits for 15s, deals a good amount of damage and freezes enemies for a short duration on the final hit. All great things, but the problem with this Echo is that it takes a while to cast and is best used pre-rotation before Intro by swap cancelling out of the final hit. This takes a lot of time to execute and is the main reason why Freezing Frost does not rank above other Glacio damage-focused sets like Frosty Resolve.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Iuno's Signature is Lingyang's best choice by virtue of its really high CRIT Rate boost, its good ATK stats, and its 36% Liberation DMG DEF Ignore and 20% DMG Bonus effects which can fully apply to Lingyang's initial Ultimate cast. In other words, the CRIT and ATK stats are great for Lingyang and it makes his initial Ultimate cast damage go way up, which makes it the best choice.

Upon casting Intro Skill, this effect reaches max stacks immediately, lasting for 3s.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Zani's Signature offers high ATK, CRIT DMG and 8% DEF Ignore for 6s when casting Basic Attacks, which is easily upkept throughout most of Lingyang's rotation. Overall a very strong generalist Gauntlets choice.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Increases ATK by {0}. Casting Basic Attack grants the following effects: Dealing damage ignores {1} of the target's DEF and Amplifies Spectro Frazzle DMG dealt by {2} for 6s. Retriggering the effect resets its duration.

best_weapons.commentary_details: High Base ATK, a good CRIT Rate stat, 12% Attribute DMG Bonus unconditionally and 48% Liberation DMG Bonus when casting Ultimate as well. Xiangli Yao's weapon provides lots of good stats, making it a highly competitive weapon choice for Lingyang.

best_weapons.commentary_details: ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Lingyang, who barely benefits from this weapon's Heavy Attack DMG-increasing effect (he does benefit from it on his Glorious Plunge attack, but it's not enough to make it rank above other limited weapon options).

best_weapons.commentary_details: Lingyang's best permanently available Gauntlets choice. Increases Energy Regen which alleviates his requirements and also provides a huge amount of ATK. The Basic and Skill DMG increases are also quite useful on Lingyang, making it a very strong choice overall.

best_weapons.commentary_details: This Battle Pass exclusive provides a great ATK and Liberation DMG increase when casting Ultimate, on top of a CRIT DMG secondary stat while retaining acceptable Base ATK. Not as favourable as Abyss Surges for Lingyang, but a very good replacement nonetheless.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Casting Resonance Liberation increases ATK by {0} and grants {1} Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Increases ATK by a good amount but also has a very niche Flat Energy restoration effect when casting Skill which helps alleviate Lingyang's Energy Regen requirements, which makes it a strong 4-star alternative.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Casting the Resonance Skill grants {0} Resonance Energy and increases ATK by {1}, lasting for 16s. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Will perform lower than Stonard if Lingyang takes any damage during his rotation. Niche 4-star weapon only worth using if nothing above is available. Gives extra ATK and DEF after using Ultimate which is only upkept consistently if the character does not take damage.

best_weapons.commentary_details: This Battle Pass exclusive gives a good amount CRIT Rate despite a rather low Base ATK and increases Liberation DMG when casting Skill. Unfortunately, this doesn't represent much of his damage total and as a result this weapon falls behind in performance when compared to some other 4-stars.

best_weapons.commentary_details: The best option that doesn't require any gacha and is permanently accessible. Simple ATK stat-stick for Lingyang who is unable to take advantage of this weapon's additional ATK boosts if Negative Statuses are applied on enemies, since none of his best teams make use of statuses currently.

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Lingyang is a 5-star Glacio Gauntlet wielder DPS that is most often played in Hyper Carry teams. As Lingyang deals the majority of his damage during his Ultimate burst window, which takes up a considerable amount of field time incentivizing him being played with supports to buff him to the max before using his Ultimate Skill. Lingyang also has very little incentive to switch out during his Ultimate burst window with it often resulting in a damage loss meaning you'll want to pair him with characters that can give him the field time he needs.

Lingyang recharges his Forte Gauge with his second Resonance Skill, Intro Skill and Ultimate Skill, though an interesting thing to note is that his Forte Gauge can be completely filled by performing his Intro followed by his Ultimate Skill once. This allows players to bypass having to use his Basic Attacks and Resonance Skill to generate Forte Gauge. Once full, he can perform a Heavy Attack to enter Striding Lion state, sending him airborne and enhancing all of his abilities for a short duration. It is during this state that Lingyang's DPS potential is at maximum and should be played attentively giving him all the buffs and support he needs during it.

Lingyang features two Resonance Skills with no cooldown. The first Resonance Skill; Ancient Arts is a simple punch that deals a small amount of Glacio damage to its target, though it is rarely used. His second Resonance Skill; Furious Punches can be only utilized after he has either used Basic Attack 3/4/5 or his Special Basic Attack - Feral Roars. This skill also deals a small amount of Glacio damage, however it generates a significant amount of his Forte Gauge along with allowing him to follow it up with Basic Attack 3 directly. This allows you to quickly juggle his Basic Attack 3 and Furious Punches, quickly filling his Forte Gauge.

His Ultimate deals a large strike in front of him, causing Glacio damage, generating Concerto Energy and a major portion of his Forte Gauge. It also increases his Glacio damage by 50% and further empowers his Forte Gauge empowerment to increase its duration.

In regards to field time, he is required to stay for the entire duration of his Ultimate enhanced Forte, which allows him to bring solid burst damage during this window. He has a unique aerial combat flair which while makes you immune to some ground attacks, also makes some significantly harder to dodge in return. This can be a drawback of his combat style, as it takes time to become accustomed to it, making actions like hitting enemies, repositioning and target changes harder to execute. Similar to Jiyan, he lacks the opportunity to leave the field mid-rotation as it causes him to lose a considerable amount of damage, making him more suited to the Hyper Carry archetype as mentioned earlier.

Lingyang is a mixed bag when it comes to play difficulty. On one hand, he is easy to play in the sense that all he requires is building enough Resonance Energy to use his Ultimate then unload all the attacks he can to maximize his damage during the burst window. On other hand, his unique Aerial combat makes it rough to navigate him, and it takes extra practice to master. Having to learn timing to dodge attacks and discern which attacks will hit you or not while airborne contributes massively to his low usage among players.
As a Main DPS he will prefer damage maximization. As such, you can equip him with damage-focused Echo and set.

Overall, due to Lingyang's damage being on the lower side of 5-stars, combined with his unique airborne gameplay that requires extra work to manage, he lags behind in usage compared to most other DPS in endgame.

synergies.commentary: Lingyang's best partners. Lynae has the strongest generalist buffs in the game and makes for a particularly strong core with Mornye to deal extra Tune Break damage and provide some the strongest array of buffs Lingyang can have. Zhezhi is also very strong by virtue of sporting good personal damage off-field via Coordinated Attacks and amazing 20% Glacio and 25% Skill DMG buffs on Outro that Lingyang very much appreciates.

One of the fastest rotation times in the game with a very good 38% Basic ATK DMG Amplify buff on Outro allows her to buff Lingyang a great amount, and allows him to take the spotlight by doing most of the team's damage. Often used if Zhezhi is taken up by another team or if you don't own her since Sanhua's free.

One of the usual Healing Support options that can slot into any team. Super easy to use, provides amazing team-wide ATK% buffs and 15% DMG Amplify with one of the fastest rotations in the game. Enjoy.

Similar to Verina, a premium Healing Support option who can not only slot into any team, but also provide insane 12.5% Crit Rate, 25% Crit DMG, 25% ATK and 15% DMG Amplify buffs to your whole team. One of the best but also easy to use characters in the game.
